title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-019
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA radar data printouts and internal memoranda regarding the Japan Air Lines Flight 1628 incident, including technical explanations for radar anomalies. / This document contains raw FAA radar data printouts and a summary page regarding the Japan Air Lines Flight 1628 UAP sighting.

incidents.summary: Japan Air Lines Flight 1628 reported an encounter with unidentified objects over Alaska, accompanied by radar returns.
Japan Air Lines Flight 1628 reported multiple unidentified objects, including two small objects and a large 'mother ship' craft, which were also tracked by FAA radar.
incidents.explanation: The document provides raw radar data printouts for the event.
incidents.quote: Pilot first questioned ARTCC re other traffic
